item.title: Councilors Flynn & Coletta Zapata Passed a Unanimous Resolution in Support of Expanding Prevention of Drink Spiking
item.description: BOSTON - This week, Boston City Councilor Ed Flynn and Councilor Gabriela Coletta Zapata passed a unanimous resolution in support of prevention and public awareness campaigns related to drink spiking in the City of Boston. Drink spiking occurs when a person deliberately puts alcohol or drugs into someone else’s drink without their knowledge or permission.
